# FTR — First Time Resolver

> IT services company in Gurugram serving businesses across India with IT infrastructure sourcing, systems integration, facility management, network support, and annual maintenance contracts since 2010.

FTR (First Time Resolver Pvt. Ltd.) brings together IT sales, hardware and software integration, and ongoing support. We start with business needs and build dependable solutions across hardware, software, networking, and workplace technology.

## Solutions

- [IT Infrastructure & Sourcing](https://ftrgroup.in/#services): Computers, laptops, servers, network switches, peripherals, and global materials sourcing.
- [Systems Integration](https://ftrgroup.in/#services): Connect platforms, applications, and data into a cohesive environment. Architecture and solution design.
- [Facility Management Services](https://ftrgroup.in/#services): Server, network and desktop support, IT asset management, and surveillance systems.
- [Annual Maintenance Contracts](https://ftrgroup.in/#services): Comprehensive coverage, proactive IT maintenance, operating system and application troubleshooting.
